verdict.rationale: Apify provides SessionPool for rotating proxy IPs/cookies and general proxy management (own, third-party, or Apify Proxy) plus datacenter/residential IP rotation to avoid blocking, and retries are supported at the API client level for failed requests. However, there's no explicit documented mechanism for automatically detecting anti-bot blocks specifically and chaining/retrying through different proxy providers/configurations in response to that detection — the rotation is proactive (session-based) rather than a documented reactive retry-on-block chain across proxy tiers. Missing for 10: explicit anti-bot-detection-triggered retry logic, documented proxy chain/fallback across different proxy groups on block, and independent/hands-on confirmation of this exact workflow.
